name: Fabricator's Gauntlets

effects.name: Strength
effects.tooltip: Strength +6 : This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Strength.

effects.name: Resistance
effects.tooltip: Resistance +5 : Passive: +5 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

effects.name: Melee Alacrity
effects.tooltip: Melee Alacrity 10% : Gain 10% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.

effects.name: Nearly Finished - Fabricator's Ingenuity
effects.tooltip: Fabricator's Ingenuity : +25% stacking fortification and +2 artifact bonus to your attack and damage rolls.

flavor_text: Fabricators of House Cannith wear bulky gauntlets like these to increase their manual strength and their ability to work with raw materials.
tips: Upgrade (becomes Bound to Character on Acquire ): + + + +

source.raw: House Cannith Manufactury , Wrack 's chest (Rare encounter)
